figurative_meaning_en: Sprinkling clumped cow dung in water, implying a natural purifying or disinfecting action
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে বাড়ি পরিষ্কার করতে গোবরছড়া করলে সব জীবাণু মরে যায়।
এই ওষুধটা গোবরছড়ার মতো কাজ করে, সব ক্ষত সাফ করে দেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: In the village, sprinkling cow dung cleans the house and kills all germs.
This medicine works like sprinkling cow dung, cleansing all wounds.
history: In traditional Bengali rural life, cow dung is smeared on floors and walls for its believed antibacterial properties, rooted in ancient Hindu practices of purification.
note: The idiom highlights the cultural use of cow dung as a natural disinfectant in agrarian Bengali society.
